summary: Old Republic International Corp filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a registered offering of senior unsecured notes. Terms are not yet fixed (principal amount, interest rate, maturity, and pricing date are blank). The notes will rank structurally junior to subsidiary liabilities. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or restructuring event is present. The filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
